selection_rule: Final source pool was locked before any Candidate-v13 external-validity performance observation. Selection used only preregistered source independence, license/provenance, source-native or deterministic gold, reproducibility, domain coverage, structural coverage, and source-family diversity. No source decision used Candidate-v13 output.

formal_primary_sources.natural_language_origin: Project-independent simulated long-form user/chatbot histories with implicit preferences; explicitly eligible under the preregistered independent synthetic-user-history source class.
formal_primary_sources.formal_role: Primary personal-preference, work, technology/device, travel, routine, update/forgetting and noisy discourse source.
formal_primary_sources.source_audit_notes: 5000/5000 rows contain user_query, correct_answer, preference and related_conversation_snippet; 1048 rows contain prev_pref and pref_type=ask_to_forget; topic fields include Work, Travel and Technology.
formal_primary_sources.raw_text_policy: Do not commit raw corpus. Regenerate from pinned public revision in controlled workflow.
